book.name: Mwɛɛm mvù Jisos to duŋcɛɛ
book.title: Ŋwa' Mwɛɛm mvù Jisos to duŋcɛɛ ɛ̂ Jon

content: Bonyii bo ntum Nyo' le bo bofɛɛ
Ɛ bó mum nɛ nya nfew ɛ̂ me ɛ wvú nu diɛwɛ kembaŋ e, gay ɛ̂ me lɛ, “Gɛnɛ efew yew ncese Nyo' bô ketaŋ ke ncese le, etaŋ tɛn bonyii bò bunlee Nyo' dvú,
geenɛn fo wo efew lakfulɛɛŋ yi ɛkfuŋ kɛ. Cinɛ dvú njefo bó nu ɛ nya wase ɛ̂ bonyii bò yaa nu kɛ Bojuu. Bó nu ke eben yî kelaante kè yuule le, envuwsɛ kelaante kedvu yî kee le mbaanyɛ ncow fɛɛ.
Me nu ŋke enya mvuŋgay ɛ̂ bonyii bem bo bofɛɛ bò jemyi ɛkumɛ me, ɛ́ bó eteete ntum wɛm ɛ̂ bonyii yî ɛdiuw e ntfuke bô gee fɛɛ kecow mbaŋsoocaan e (1,260). Bó nu ke eteete ɛ bó ɛ jise bimbamkpwe.”
Bonyii bo bofɛɛ ban nu bite bi Olif e bi bifɛɛ noo mwɛɛm mvu mvunfɛɛm mvù bó tomyi bin'yeese yî dvú le mvù ké no leeme fwe dvu Tata wvù kɛŋke nshɛ.
Ɛ́ wee ke enɛ ɛ no gomte keege fiɛɛ fì befe bô bó, ɛ́ ŋguy ebuy dew yibole efiese lo wee wvubo bvuban wvudvu. Ɛ̀ nɛɛ no wee gomte keege fiɛɛ fì befe bô bó tu wvú kɛŋke keekpwe nonɛn.

Bó kɛŋke mvuŋgay mvù ɛ̀ nulo ɛ́ bó ebaŋ ɛbulɛ lɛ fo jaŋ ecem naa lo yî nshɛ le ɛdiuw yò bó nu eteete ntum Nyo' le. Ɛ bó kɛŋke tɛn mvuŋgay mvù ɛ̀ nulo ɛ́ bó ebaŋke jóo ɛ́ yí etu ɛlɛmɛ noo mvuŋgay keelaŋ dikfuu di bimfim e yî nshɛ le naa seke la wvù bó shieele.
Bó nu ke edioo ɛ mɛse ɛ jeme fiɛɛ fì bó kɛŋke keejeme, ɛ́ nyam yì bɛmte yì buyte ɛ̂ kentuke kiɛ kè shiile nɛn ŋooŋŋ e, ebuy etum jem bô bó, eso bó, eyuwyɛ bó,
ɛ́ ɛgvun ɛbo emɛy ejiime ɛ̂ je ɛ̂ kelaante ke baay e. Kelaante kin nu kè bó teŋe ɛ̂ díɛw yi mawɛɛn e lɛ Sodom kɛnɛɛ lɛ Ijiw, ɛ ɛ̀ nu jó jò bó to taɛ Tata wvubo yî kentam e.

Yî ɛdiuw e ɛta bô keŋgawtɛn nu ɛ dikfuu di bonyii le, kɛnɛɛ ɛ̀ nu bo ntɛw wvù la le, kɛnɛɛ bò jemyi kfuu díɛw yì la, kɛnɛɛ bo bitum bì la le, nu ke etaale ɛgvun ɛbo no yó jiimene, etun lɛ fo bó edwey bó kɛ.

Bonyii bò ɛ̀ nu bo yî woŋ wvun e nu ke elaŋlaŋe laa ɛ̀ kpwese bonyii ban ɛ kpwekɛn ɛ. Bó nu ke esakene lo, ɛ wee ciinse nnya ɛ̂ wee, ɛ wee ciinse nnya ɛ̂ wee. Bó nu ke egee nonɛn njefo bonyii bo ntum Nyo' le bo bofɛɛ ban nu ɛ to bô ŋgɛw wvu baay yî bonyii bò ɛ̀ nu bo yî woŋ e.
Ɛ fí ke kooy, ɛ ɛdiuw yo ɛta bô keŋgawtɛn ɛyan ke fey, ɛ keyoy kè nyaa nshii nɛ fô Nyo' le, ley yî bó le, ɛ bó kase ja we. Ɛ bonyii yɛn nonɛn, kɛŋkɛ nfan baay.
Ɛ bonyii bo bofɛɛ bodvu mum yuw ɛ diɛw jeme we bô mvuŋgay gayte ɛ̂ bó lɛ, “Ben eben eto fɛn!” Ɛ bó mum no bene gɛne we ɛ̂ kembɛw e, ɛ bonyii bobole bo bvuban e taale.

Kɛ kefew kedvu le, ɛ nshɛ nɛ shiw bô mvuŋgay baay, ɛ keba kemwaaŋ ɛnte jo yuufe jo kelaante kedvu bvusɛ. Ɛ bonyii bontfuke bosooshwiy (7,000) kpwekɛn no nshɛ yidvu to shiwɛɛ. Ɛ kebɛse ke bonyii bò to shɛkɛɛ le, kɛŋkɛ nfan baay, no tumte moŋkum mo Nyo' wvù nu we le.
Wvun wvù fey nu ŋgɛw wvu bokaŋ bofɛɛ. Geenɛn ben eyekɛ eyuw, ŋgɛw wvu bokaŋ botɛte nu eto nfew caan.
Ɛ bó toŋ soŋ yi bokaŋ bosooshwiy

Ɛ nceendaa Nyo' wvu bokaŋ bosooshwiy ke toŋ ye soŋ, ɛ me n'yuw no díɛw jemyi bô mvuŋgay we gayte lɛ, “Bvunfon bvu yî woŋ wvun e nu ɛ tu wase bvu Tata wesebeene bô Mboyse we wvù wvú to kawɛɛ le, ɛ wvú nu ke esaake sekecii sɛ ŋka.”
Ɛ bocɛ' bo bonyii le bo mbaanfiɛɛ ncow bonɛw ba bò shiilɛɛ yî bokawla bobole fwe dvu Nyo' mum no gbwee tumte monshim mobole fokuse, nyaa mbense wvu baay ɛ̂ Nyo'.
Ɛ bó no gee nonɛn, gayte lɛ,

content.text: Tata Nyo' wvù Kɛŋke Mvuŋgay Mvunciim,
wo nu keseen, ɛ wo to nu wase.
Bese nyaa keyoone njefo wo nu ɛ jo wase
mvuŋgay mvuw mvu baay ɛ kɛw ɛ no saake.
Bonyii bò yaa kee kɛ wo
ɛ kefew kè wo nu eduŋcɛ shém yo yì ffuuke nu ɛ kocɛn wase.
Ɛ ɛ̀ nu kefew kè wo nu esaw bonyii bò nu ɛ kpwekɛn wase.
Ɛ ɛ̀ bvuu nu tɛn kè wo nu emawcɛ bonyii buw bo lemme le
bò ɛ̀ nu bonyii buw bo ntum e,
ebvuu emawcɛ bonyii bò ɛ̀ nu bo Nyo' le,
emawcɛ tɛn bonyii bocii bò wvumte diee diuw,
kɛnɛɛ ɛ̀ nu bo caan caan kɛnɛɛ bo baay baay.
Ɛ ɛ̀ nu tɛn kefew kè wo nu elɛse bonyii
bò beete bô ɛkolɛ ke nshɛ le.”

content: Ɛ bó nɛ yene kembuŋ ke yew ncese Nyo' yi fowe le. Ɛ ŋkuw moŋkan mo Nyo' le wvù to nu yew ncese yidvu le yenɛ. Ɛ jaŋ nɛ no lawkene, baykene, dvûmte, ɛ nshɛ shiike, ɛ ɛbew yo baay baay shiile.

footnotes.text: Bonyii ban fɛn nu ɛ bó teŋe bó teytey lɛ, «bitum».
